description.value: Pearl Fever Tea House is a bubble tea chain rooted in the lower mainland since 2002, now operating six locations dedicated to handcrafted Asian tea drinks. The Coquitlam-origin brand emphasizes consistency and customization across its menu of taro, matcha, mango, and other specialty drinks. A touring cyclist stopping in would find a quick, refreshing drink stop — particularly appealing on warm-weather routes through the Fraser Valley corridor.
